scope: TF-0670 object/role/scope/owner contract, not autonomous product execution

criteria.criterion: Explicit owner and project/workspace/session/generation; reject bare/mixed/stale/cross-scope pointers
Explicit 1:1 Project mapping and one-way Forest execution anchor without status mirroring
Existing ontology validator, semantic authority checker and Host API contract check
Static grant metadata and Run completion cannot invent runtime authority or task acceptance
Clean candidate, input/config hashes, observed commands/counts, raw recovery and agent attribution
Static manifest owner/allow mutation cannot change actual Main permission checks; missing workspace owner fails closed

limitations: New adapters are not yet wired to automatic task writes, dispatch, UI or resource effects; A2/A4/U1 and subsequent leaves own those consumers.
No live provider quality, packaged app, non-Windows platform, long-running autonomous deployment or publication acceptance is claimed.
Full project release acceptance and Agent Dev maturity do not follow from these scoped contract gates.
